challenge_facts_addressed.effect_on_judgment: Two Alex-initiated one-on-one plans, especially the Saturday museum visit, meaningfully support special interest, though C1-F4 shows Alex also makes one-on-one plans with other friends.

Remembering the presentation, sending encouragement, and bringing Jordan's preferred tea demonstrate personalized attention, but Alex's general pattern of checking in and bringing treats to others limits how clearly this distinguishes Jordan.
Four extended private text conversations show sustained interest in Jordan's company and provide the strongest challenge to B, but they do not by themselves establish special or romantic interest.

reason_for_retaining_or_changing: B remains somewhat better supported because Alex displays comparable warmth and one-on-one friendliness toward others (C1-F4), gave no explicit romantic indication over ten weeks (C1-F5), and twice postponed Jordan's dinner without proposing a replacement date during the next two weeks (C1-F6). C1-F1 through C1-F3 nevertheless provide meaningful evidence for A, so confidence in B is moderate rather than high.

revised_recommended_action.explanation: Continue at the current level while observing whether Alex follows through on further one-on-one contact or otherwise distinguishes Jordan from Alex's general pattern of friendliness.
